meta.title: Fatesaid Q&A 질문 뱅크
meta.note: Fully translated into ko/en/es. Universally relatable topics by design — no Korea-specific cultural elements (holidays, talismans, incantations, etc.).

questions.text_ko: 나는 언제쯤 진짜 사랑을 만날 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: When will I finally meet real love?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo voy a encontrar el amor verdadero?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 어울리는 사람은 어떤 성격일까?
questions.text_en: What personality would suit me well?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué personalidad tiene la persona que mejor encaja conmigo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 자꾸 비슷한 사람에게 끌릴까?
questions.text_en: Why do I keep being drawn to the same type of person?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué me atrae siempre el mismo tipo de persona?

questions.text_ko: 첫눈에 반하는 사랑이 나에게도 올까?
questions.text_en: Will love at first sight happen to me too?
questions.text_es: ¿Viviré alguna vez un amor a primera vista?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 곳에서 인연을 만나게 될까?
questions.text_en: Where am I likely to meet someone special?
questions.text_es: ¿Dónde es probable que conozca a alguien especial?

questions.text_ko: 지금 솔로인 이유가 사주에도 나와 있을까?
questions.text_en: Does my saju show why I'm single right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Muestra mi saju por qué sigo sin pareja ahora mismo?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 호감을 갖고 있는 사람이 주변에 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there someone nearby who's interested in me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay cerca de mí alguien a quien le intereso?

questions.text_ko: 나는 연애를 시작하기에 좋은 시기일까?
questions.text_en: Is this a good time for me to start dating?
questions.text_es: ¿Es este un buen momento para empezar a salir con alguien?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 사람에게 매력을 느끼는 편일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of person am I usually drawn to?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué tipo de persona suele atraerme?

questions.text_ko: 소개팅이나 새로운 만남이 잘 풀릴 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a good period coming up for a blind date or new meeting?
questions.text_es: ¿Se acerca un buen momento para una cita a ciegas o para conocer a alguien nuevo?

questions.text_ko: 나는 사랑에 있어 어떤 실수를 반복하는 편일까?
questions.text_en: What mistake do I tend to repeat in love?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué error tiendo a repetir en el amor?

questions.text_ko: 나와 잘 맞는 사람의 특징은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What traits does someone who's a good match for me have?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo es la persona que sería una buena pareja para mí?

questions.text_ko: 나는 먼저 다가가는 편이 좋을까, 기다리는 편이 좋을까?
questions.text_en: Is it better for me to approach first, or wait?
questions.text_es: ¿Es mejor para mí dar el primer paso, o esperar?

questions.text_ko: 나의 이상형과 실제로 잘 맞는 사람은 다를까?
questions.text_en: Is the person who's actually right for me different from my ideal type?
questions.text_es: ¿Es distinta de mi tipo ideal la persona que de verdad me conviene?

questions.text_ko: 온라인에서 만난 인연도 잘 이어질 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can a connection made online actually work out?
questions.text_es: ¿Puede funcionar una relación que empieza en línea?

questions.text_ko: 나는 연애를 할 때 어떤 점을 가장 중요하게 볼까?
questions.text_en: What do I value most when I'm dating someone?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué es lo que más valoro cuando salgo con alguien?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 어울리는 나이대나 성향의 상대가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there an age range or personality type that suits me?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un rango de edad o tipo de personalidad que me convenga?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 마음에 드는 사람 앞에서 소극적으로 변할까?
questions.text_en: Why do I become passive around someone I like?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué me retraigo ante alguien que me gusta?

questions.text_ko: 지금 내 곁에 좋은 인연이 다가오고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is a good connection approaching me right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Se me acerca una buena conexión en este momento?

questions.text_ko: 나는 어떤 방식으로 사랑을 표현하는 사람일까?
questions.text_en: What's my way of expressing love?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es mi forma de expresar el amor?

questions.text_ko: 나는 언제쯤 결혼하게 될까?
questions.text_en: When will I get married?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo me voy a casar?

questions.text_ko: 나와 결혼할 사람은 어떤 사람일까?
questions.text_en: What kind of person will I marry?
questions.text_es: ¿Con qué tipo de persona me voy a casar?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼 생활에서 어떤 점을 중요하게 여길까?
questions.text_en: What will matter most to me in married life?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué será lo más importante para mí en la vida matrimonial?

questions.text_ko: 결혼 상대는 나와 성격이 비슷할까, 다를까?
questions.text_en: Will my spouse have a similar personality to mine, or a different one?
questions.text_es: ¿Tendrá mi pareja una personalidad similar a la mía, o diferente?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼을 서두르는 게 좋을까, 천천히 하는 게 좋을까?
questions.text_en: Should I rush into marriage, or take it slow?
questions.text_es: ¿Debería darme prisa en casarme, o tomármelo con calma?

questions.text_ko: 나의 결혼 생활은 안정적일까?
questions.text_en: Will my married life be stable?
questions.text_es: ¿Será estable mi vida matrimonial?

questions.text_ko: 나는 배우자와 오래도록 좋은 관계를 유지할 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can I maintain a good relationship with my spouse long-term?
questions.text_es: ¿Podré mantener una buena relación con mi pareja a largo plazo?

questions.text_ko: 결혼 상대를 이미 알고 지내는 사이일 수도 있을까?
questions.text_en: Could I already know the person I'll marry?
questions.text_es: ¿Es posible que ya haya conocido a la persona con la que me voy a casar?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 결혼하기 좋은 시기는 언제일까?
questions.text_en: When's a good time for me to get married?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo sería un buen momento para casarme?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼 후에도 지금의 목표를 이어갈 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can I keep pursuing my current goals even after marriage?
questions.text_es: ¿Podré seguir persiguiendo mis metas actuales incluso después de casarme?

questions.text_ko: 나의 배우자는 나에게 어떤 존재가 되어줄까?
questions.text_en: What will my spouse become to me?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué papel tendrá mi pareja en mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼을 앞두고 무엇을 준비해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I prepare for before getting married?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué debería preparar antes de casarme?

questions.text_ko: 청혼을 받게 된다면 그 시기는 언제쯤일까?
questions.text_en: If I get a proposal, around when might that be?
questions.text_es: Si me proponen matrimonio, ¿más o menos cuándo sería?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼 후 지금 사는 곳에서 계속 살게 될까?
questions.text_en: Will I keep living where I live now after marriage?
questions.text_es: ¿Seguiré viviendo donde vivo ahora después de casarme?

questions.text_ko: 나와 배우자는 경제적으로 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: Will my spouse and I be financially compatible?
questions.text_es: ¿Nos llevaremos bien mi pareja y yo en temas de dinero?

questions.text_ko: 나의 결혼 생활에서 가장 큰 어려움은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What will be the biggest challenge in my married life?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál será el mayor desafío en mi vida matrimonial?

questions.text_ko: 나는 결혼을 통해 어떤 변화를 겪게 될까?
questions.text_en: What changes will I go through because of marriage?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué cambios traerá el matrimonio a mi vida?

questions.text_ko: 지금 만나는 사람과 결혼까지 이어질 가능성이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a chance my current relationship leads to marriage?
questions.text_es: ¿Podría mi relación actual llevar al matrimonio?

questions.text_ko: 나에게 잘 맞는 결혼 상대의 나이대나 배경이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there an age range or background that suits my future spouse?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una franja de edad o un entorno que le convenga a mi futura pareja?

questions.text_ko: 나는 나중에 배우자와 어떤 모습으로 살아가게 될까?
questions.text_en: What will my life with my spouse look like later on?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo será mi vida junto a mi pareja más adelante?

questions.text_ko: 지금 만나는 사람과 나는 얼마나 잘 맞을까?
questions.text_en: How compatible am I with the person I'm seeing now?
questions.text_es: ¿Hasta qué punto somos compatibles la persona con la que estoy y yo?

questions.text_ko: 이 관계는 앞으로 더 좋아질까?
questions.text_en: Will this relationship keep getting better?
questions.text_es: ¿Seguirá mejorando esta relación?

questions.text_ko: 지금 상대방은 나를 진심으로 생각하고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Does this person truly care about me?
questions.text_es: ¿Le importo de verdad a esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 우리 사이에 곧 중요한 변화가 생길까?
questions.text_en: Will an important change happen between us soon?
questions.text_es: ¿Ocurrirá pronto un cambio importante entre nosotros?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 관계에서 무엇을 놓치고 있을까?
questions.text_en: What am I missing in this relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué estoy pasando por alto en esta relación?

questions.text_ko: 우리가 자주 다투는 이유는 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: Why do we argue so often?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué discutimos tanto?

questions.text_ko: 지금 관계를 더 발전시키려면 무엇이 필요할까?
questions.text_en: What do we need to take this relationship further?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué necesitamos para llevar esta relación más lejos?

questions.text_ko: 상대방과 나는 서로에게 얼마나 솔직할까?
questions.text_en: How honest are we with each other?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuánta honestidad hay entre nosotros?

questions.text_ko: 우리 관계가 힘든 시기를 지나고 있는 걸까?
questions.text_en: Is our relationship going through a rough patch?
questions.text_es: ¿Está pasando nuestra relación por un momento difícil?

questions.text_ko: 지금 상대와 계속 만나는 게 맞는 선택일까?
questions.text_en: Is staying with this person the right choice?
questions.text_es: ¿Es quedarme con esta persona la decisión correcta?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 관계에서 너무 많이 맞추고 있는 건 아닐까?
questions.text_en: Am I compromising too much in this relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Estoy cediendo demasiado en esta relación?

questions.text_ko: 상대방의 진심을 확인하고 싶은데 방법이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a way to find out their true feelings?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una forma de descubrir sus verdaderos sentimientos?

questions.text_ko: 지금 연인과 나는 가치관이 잘 맞는 편일까?
questions.text_en: Do my partner and I share similar values?
questions.text_es: ¿Compartimos mi pareja y yo valores similares?

questions.text_ko: 우리 관계에서 내가 놓치고 있는 신호가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a sign in this relationship I'm missing?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una señal en esta relación que se me esté escapando?

questions.text_ko: 상대방과 함께 있을 때 나는 나답게 지내고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Am I being myself when I'm with them?
questions.text_es: ¿Me muestro tal como soy cuando estoy con esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 이 사람과 미래를 그려도 괜찮을까?
questions.text_en: Is it okay to picture a future with this person?
questions.text_es: ¿Está bien imaginar un futuro con esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 지금 관계에서 내가 더 노력해야 할 부분이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there something I should be trying harder at in this relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay algo en lo que debería esforzarme más en esta relación?

questions.text_ko: 우리 사이에 신뢰가 충분히 쌓여 있을까?
questions.text_en: Have we built enough trust between us?
questions.text_es: ¿Hemos construido suficiente confianza entre nosotros?

questions.text_ko: 상대방이 나에게 서운함을 느끼고 있진 않을까?
questions.text_en: Could they be feeling hurt by me?
questions.text_es: ¿Es posible que esta persona sienta que le he fallado?

questions.text_ko: 이 관계가 나에게 정말 좋은 영향을 주고 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is this relationship really having a good effect on me?
questions.text_es: ¿Está teniendo esta relación un efecto realmente bueno en mí?

questions.text_es: ¿Le intereso yo también a esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 이 마음을 고백하면 어떻게 될까?
questions.text_en: What would happen if I confessed my feelings?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué pasaría si le confesara mis sentimientos?

questions.text_ko: 지금 이 애매한 관계는 앞으로 어떻게 될까?
questions.text_en: Where is this ambiguous relationship headed?
questions.text_es: ¿Hacia dónde va esta relación sin definir?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 자꾸 이 사람에게 마음이 갈까?
questions.text_en: Why do I keep being drawn to this person?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué me sigue atrayendo esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 이 사람과 나는 정말 인연이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Do this person and I really have a connection?
questions.text_es: ¿De verdad hay una conexión entre esta persona y yo?

questions.text_ko: 짝사랑하는 이 마음을 접는 게 나을까?
questions.text_en: Would it be better to let go of this crush?
questions.text_es: ¿Sería mejor dejar ir este enamoramiento?

questions.text_ko: 그 사람에게 다가가기 좋은 시기가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a good time for me to approach them?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay un buen momento para acercarme a esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 마음을 표현하는 게 이렇게 어려울까?
questions.text_en: Why is it so hard for me to express my feelings?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué me cuesta tanto expresar mis sentimientos?

questions.text_ko: 그 사람의 진심을 어떻게 알 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: How can I find out their true feelings?
questions.text_es: ¿Cómo puedo descubrir sus verdaderos sentimientos?

questions.text_ko: 지금 썸 타는 상대와 잘 될 가능성이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a real chance with the person I'm "talking to" right now?
questions.text_es: ¿Tengo posibilidades reales con la persona con la que estoy ahora, sin nada definido?

questions.text_ko: 나만 좋아하는 짝사랑으로 끝나게 될까?
questions.text_en: Will this end up as a one-sided crush?
questions.text_es: ¿Terminará esto siendo un amor no correspondido?

questions.text_ko: 그 사람과 나 사이에 흐르는 미묘한 감정은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's this subtle feeling flowing between us?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué es esa sensación sutil que hay entre nosotros?

questions.text_ko: 고백 타이밍을 놓친 건 아닐까?
questions.text_en: Did I miss my window to confess?
questions.text_es: ¿Se me pasó el momento de confesar mis sentimientos?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 사람에게 어떤 인상으로 남아 있을까?
questions.text_en: What kind of impression have I left on this person?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué impresión le he dejado a esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 그 사람이 나를 밀어내는 이유가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a reason they're pushing me away?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una razón por la que esta persona me mantiene a distancia?

questions.text_ko: 우리 사이가 애매한 채로 계속 이어지는 이유는 뭘까?
questions.text_en: Why does this stay stuck in this ambiguous state?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué esto no termina de definirse?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 감정을 어떻게 정리하면 좋을까?
questions.text_en: How should I go about sorting out this feeling?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué debería hacer con este sentimiento?

questions.text_ko: 그 사람과 가까워질 계기가 생길까?
questions.text_en: Will there be a moment that brings us closer?
questions.text_es: ¿Habrá un momento que nos acerque más?

questions.text_ko: 짝사랑이 결실을 맺으려면 무엇이 필요할까?
questions.text_en: What does it take for a crush like this to work out?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué se necesita para que un enamoramiento como este funcione?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 관계에서 상처받지 않을 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can I avoid getting hurt in this situation?
questions.text_es: ¿Puedo evitar que esta situación me haga daño?

questions.text_ko: 헤어진 그 사람과 다시 만날 가능성이 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a chance I'll get back with my ex?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una posibilidad de que vuelva con mi ex?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 이별을 잘 극복할 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Will I be able to get through this breakup well?
questions.text_es: ¿Podré superar bien esta ruptura?

questions.text_ko: 헤어진 이유가 정말 나 때문이었을까?
questions.text_en: Was the breakup really my fault?
questions.text_es: ¿Fue mía la culpa de la ruptura?

questions.text_ko: 전 연인은 지금 나를 어떻게 생각하고 있을까?
questions.text_en: What does my ex think of me now?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué piensa mi ex de mí ahora?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이 이별에서 무엇을 배워야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I learn from this breakup?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué debería aprender de esta ruptura?

questions.text_ko: 다시 연락이 온다면 어떻게 해야 할까?
questions.text_en: What should I do if they reach out again?
questions.text_es: ¿Qué debería hacer si esta persona vuelve a contactarme?

questions.text_ko: 나는 언제쯤 이 아픔에서 완전히 벗어날 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: When will I fully get over this pain?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuándo voy a superar por completo este dolor?

questions.text_ko: 헤어진 사람을 잊지 못하는 이유가 있을까?
questions.text_en: Is there a reason I can't forget this person?
questions.text_es: ¿Hay una razón por la que no puedo olvidar a esta persona?

questions.text_ko: 재회한다면 이번엔 다를 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: If we got back together, could it be different this time?
questions.text_es: Si volviéramos, ¿podría ser diferente esta vez?

questions.text_ko: 나는 이별 후 어떤 사람으로 성장하게 될까?
questions.text_en: What kind of person will I become after this breakup?
questions.text_es: ¿En qué tipo de persona me convertiré después de esta ruptura?

questions.text_ko: 전 연인과 다시 좋은 관계로 지낼 수 있을까?
questions.text_en: Can my ex and I stay on good terms?
questions.text_es: ¿Podremos mi ex y yo llevarnos bien?

questions.text_ko: 이별이 나에게 남긴 가장 큰 교훈은 무엇일까?
questions.text_en: What's the biggest lesson this breakup has left me?
questions.text_es: ¿Cuál es la lección más importante que me deja esta ruptura?

questions.text_ko: 나는 왜 자꾸 지난 관계를 되돌아보게 될까?
questions.text_en: Why do I keep looking back on this past relationship?
questions.text_es: ¿Por qué sigo mirando atrás, a esa relación?
